_meta.status: DRAFT: English interface strings. The referral, not-found and disclaimer wording need review by the Sharia mentor.

tagline: Verify verses and hadith before you share them
disclaimer: An AI-assisted tool. It checks texts; it does not issue fatwas and does not replace a qualified scholar.
privacy: We do not store the texts you enter.
input_label: Paste a verse, a hadith or a viral post (Arabic)
input_placeholder: Paste the Arabic text of the verse or hadith here…
error_generic: We could not check this right now. Check your connection and try again in a moment.
error_too_long: The text is too long. Shorten it to at most {n} characters and try again.
empty_input: Type or paste a text first.

status.near_match: Close to a known text (possibly narrated by meaning)
status.not_found: Not found in the indexed sources

not_found_note: This does not mean the text is false; we only did not find it in the sources we index. Please consult a qualified scholar.
too_short_note: The text is too short to check reliably. Enter at least three words.
referral: This question needs a qualified scholar. This tool only checks the texts of verses and hadith and does not issue fatwas. Please consult a recognised fatwa authority.
out_of_scope: This is outside the tool's scope. It checks texts of the Holy Quran and the two Sahihs only.
quran_source_name: Madinah Mushaf, Hafs narration (King Fahd Glorious Quran Printing Complex)

diff.replace: Your text has «{quote}» where the source has «{source}».
diff.insert: Extra word not in the source: «{quote}».
diff.delete: Missing word that is in the source: «{source}».
diff.spelling: Spelling difference only: «{quote}»; the source has «{source}».

explain_template.exact: Your text matches {ref}, ignoring diacritics and recitation marks.
explain_template.lexical_diff: Your text is close to {ref} but has {n} wording difference(s), shown below. The correct text is in the “Text from the source” box.
explain_template.near_match: Your text resembles {ref} in meaning but with different wording; it may be narrated by meaning. Please refer to the original text.
explain_template.not_found: We did not find this text in the sources we index; this is not a judgement on it.

paths_subtitle: Learn about Islam step by step, with verification built into every lesson.
paths_empty: The paths are being prepared and will be added after review.
footer_sources: Sources: King Fahd Glorious Quran Printing Complex; HadeethEnc.com; QuranEnc.com.
partial_note: Partial quotation: your text is part of the verse; the full verse is shown in the “Text from the source” box.
also_in: The same text also appears in: {refs}.
hadith_source_name: The Encyclopedia of Translated Prophetic Hadiths (HadeethEnc.com)
report_button: Report an error in this result
report_consent: I agree that my text, the result and my comment are saved, only to review the error.
report_need_consent: The report is saved only after you agree.
report_thanks: Thank you, we received your report and will review it.
report_failed: We could not send the report now. Please try later.
progress_local_note: Your progress is saved only in your browser; we store nothing.
not_found_page: We could not find this page.
box_meaning: Meaning and translation from approved sources
meaning_note: The tafsir, explanation and translation are quoted exactly from their sources; nothing here is AI-generated.
meaning_en_missing: No English translation of this hadith is available from the source.
cited_not_indexed: Not verified in our indexed sources. You can check it or consult its source.
cited_quote: A quotation given by the lesson's author; you can check it.
lesson_text_arabic_note: The lesson text is in Arabic. Verses and hadith include an approved English translation (open the English section under each).
guide_intro: Ask about a topic and I'll point you to the right lessons in our paths. I don't issue fatwas or write religious texts.
guide_placeholder: e.g. How do I perform wudu?
guide_found: These lessons from our paths may help (lessons are in Arabic):
guide_none: I couldn't find a matching lesson. Try other words, or browse the paths.
guide_empty: Type your question or the topic you want to learn.
guide_verify_hint: Your question seems to contain a verse or hadith. You can check it with the verifier.
guide_error: Search is unavailable right now; try again shortly.
